label: Go live
title: Your stage starts here.
body: Set up your camera, choose your room, and bring your audience together.
alt: An African creator preparing to perform on a circular stage, with her phone on a tripod and city lights beyond.

label: The performance
title: Local roots. A wider audience.
body: Perform live with chat and gifts in the same room, connecting fans at home and across the diaspora.
alt: The same creator singing under a gold spotlight, surrounded by a seated audience and gold light trails.

label: Every gift
title: Support you can account for.
body: Keep 60% of each gift, with the fan’s coins, your earnings, and the platform’s share recorded in the ledger.
alt: Gold light trails connect the audience to the creator through a transparent glass panel representing the ledger.

label: Your earnings
title: Your performance. Your earnings.
body: See your earnings and request a payout when eligible. Follow its progress through review and payment.
alt: The creator after her performance, with gold trails stretching toward distant city lights.
